data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 6/6): Two narrow runtime edge cases. (1) ensure_log_group: wrap create-log-group with ResourceAlreadyExistsException exit-code classifier — describe+create has eventually-consistent race; current set -euo pipefail propagates non-zero on already-exists, but lambda_function_name was already EARLY-written so partial-state recovery breaks. Add: 'create-log-group invocation tolerates ResourceAlreadyExistsException via exit-code classification' (grep -q ResourceAlreadyExistsException aws-setup-lambda.sh). (2) reserved-concurrency: existing value of 0 (function blocked) ≠ 'no limit set' ≠ '10'. Idempotency check MUST compare ReservedConcurrentExecutions == 10 numerically, NOT use [[ -z \ ]] which would re-fire put on explicitly-blocked function.
